Subject: SOC2 access request and delegation for upcoming review

Hi Rachel,

We have our scheduled walkthrough for ACME Financial on 2027-04-18 (SOC 2 Type II sampling). To streamline the evidence collection, can Redwood provision access for two reviewers and allow a temporary delegated auditor account? Our lead will be myself (David Leong) and our emcee for evidence pulls will be Sara Lin (sara.lin@acme.com).

Specific asks:  
- One-time secure portal invite for Sara (view + download, no admin)
- A rolling 72-hour download window aligned to the days we ask for evidence (we may request staggered days)
- Option to request a signed bridg e/affirmation letter for the partial period we sampled (if needed)

Attached is a short checklist of docs we typically pull. Please let me know who I should liaise with on your side to confirm timings.

Thanks,
David

- Sara's invite was accepted and the reviewer role is scoped (view + download). We will not expose admin controls.
- The two 72-hour download windows are scheduled exactly as requested. Tokens will be issued at the start time (UTC) and expire after 72 hours.
- Packaging: we'll pre-stage the ACME-Audit folder and queue a zip export for the first window. If you need incremental exports during the window, use the portal request button and we'll process within the SLA.
- Bridge letter: draft attached (bridge-letter-draft.docx). This is an internal draft for legal to review; let us know if edits are required.
- Evidence index template attached (evidence-index.csv). Please populate any additional document IDs you want staged in the zip.

Operational contact for the sessions: kimberly_park@redwood.ai. For urgent issues on the day, call +1-555-0102.
